##### Project general facts

Stonehenge II is a distinguished residential complex developed by the renowned Segrex Family, a stalwart in the local business market since 1995 with a proven track record of strategic growth and diversified excellence. This visionary development embraces a modern Scandinavian architectural style, characterized by clean lines, minimalist aesthetics, and a harmonious connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. The complex features a thoughtfully curated selection of residences including studios and one and two-bedroom apartments, all designed to provide the ultimate in comfortable living and investment potential. Every aspect of Stonehenge II has been meticulously planned to create a welcoming environment where residents can truly feel that Dubai feels like home, reflecting the developer's commitment to building for comfortable life and lasting value.

The development boasts an impressive array of premium amenities designed to enhance every aspect of daily life, with a magnificent rooftop infinity pool that offers breathtaking views over the city skyline. Residents can maintain their wellness routine in the spacious fitness center equipped with Technogym fitness equipment, complemented by luxurious sauna and hammam facilities for ultimate relaxation. The thoughtfully designed courtyard creates a magical space for families, featuring charming walking paths with colorful stepping stones and child-friendly wonders including a tiny fairy garden and playful sculptures. Additional conveniences include multiple underground parking floors with electric vehicle charging stations, dedicated storage for bicycles and electric scooters, and a welcoming reception desk with comfortable lounge areas featuring upholstered sofas and armchairs.

Each residence at Stonehenge II showcases modern Scandinavian-inspired interiors with meticulous attention to detail and high-quality finishes throughout. The kitchens are equipped with premium Bosch appliances including oven, microwave, gas stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, and washing machine, ensuring effortless culinary experiences. The apartments feature advanced air purification through G4/F6 filtration systems, providing residents with a healthy and comfortable indoor environment at all times. An innovative cold water cooling system ensures that tap water is always refreshingly chilled, adding an extra touch of everyday luxury. Selected two-bedroom apartments on the upper floors feature private terraces with magnificent views, accessible via a silent hydraulic elevator directly from the apartments, offering an unparalleled blend of tranquility and city living.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious residential development is situated in Jumeirah Village Circle, a vibrant community nestled in the heart of new Dubai that has become one of the city's most desirable residential destinations. The neighborhood offers an exceptional quality of life with its thoughtfully planned layout, abundant green spaces, and family-friendly atmosphere that appeals to discerning residents seeking both comfort and convenience. The area is characterized by its modern infrastructure and a harmonious blend of residential tranquility with easy access to urban amenities.

The location offers remarkable convenience with a wealth of essential services and attractions within walking distance, including kindergartens and prestigious educational institutions that make it an ideal choice for families. The nearby Circle Mall provides a comprehensive shopping and dining experience, while the expansive Rem Ram Park offers extensive walking trails and active outdoor games areas equipped with playgrounds and special lawns for pets. Major shopping destinations including Dubai Hills Mall and the vibrant Dubai Marina are just minutes away, offering endless entertainment and lifestyle options.

The strategic positioning ensures excellent connectivity to Dubai's key destinations, with Dubai International Airport easily accessible for frequent travelers. The neighborhood benefits from a mature community infrastructure that has been carefully developed to meet the needs of modern urban living. This distinguished location represents the perfect balance of peaceful suburban living and urban accessibility, offering residents an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most dynamic and rapidly developing residential corridors. The combination of green spaces, premium surroundings, and exceptional connectivity makes this area truly exceptional for those seeking a vibrant yet serene living environment.
